source.title: Chapter 11 — Basic Properties of Circles (I), Chapter Summary

usage: Use the abbreviation verbatim in anim.steps[].ref, including parentheses.
Use ∠ or ∠s for angles and ⊥ for perpendicular; do not use private-use characters extracted from the PDF.
○ᶜᵉ represents the textbook circle symbol with superscript ce, meaning circumference.
Choose the theorem in the direction actually used; a converse has its own abbreviation.
The arc, chord and angle comparisons require the same circle or equal circles; match corresponding arcs and angles.
For a concyclicity test, check the point positions and same-side/opposite-side angle configuration.
Basic angle rules below are supplementary existing conventions, not quotations from these three summary pages.

meaning.en: The central angle is twice the angle at the circumference standing on the same arc.
meaning.zh: 同弧的圓心角是圓周角的兩倍。

meaning.en: Angles in the same segment are equal.
meaning.zh: 同弓形內的圓周角相等。

meaning.en: The angle in a semicircle is a right angle.
meaning.zh: 半圓內的圓周角是直角。

meaning.en: A right angle at the circumference subtends a diameter.
meaning.zh: 圓周上的直角所對的弦是直徑。

meaning.en: A perpendicular from the centre to a chord bisects the chord.
meaning.zh: 圓心到弦的垂線平分弦。

centre_to_chord_midpoint.abbreviation: (line joining centre to mid-pt. of chord ⊥ chord)

meaning.en: The line joining the centre to the midpoint of a chord is perpendicular to the chord.
meaning.zh: 圓心連弦中點的直線垂直於弦。

chord_perpendicular_bisector.abbreviation: (⊥ bisector of chord passes through centre)

meaning.en: The perpendicular bisector of a chord passes through the centre.
meaning.zh: 弦的垂直平分線經圓心。

meaning.en: Equal chords are equidistant from the centre.
meaning.zh: 等弦與圓心等距。

meaning.en: Chords equidistant from the centre are equal.
meaning.zh: 與圓心等距的弦長度相等。

meaning.en: Equal corresponding angles stand on equal arcs.
meaning.zh: 相等的對應角所對的弧相等。

meaning.en: Equal arcs subtend equal corresponding angles.
meaning.zh: 等弧所對的對應角相等。

meaning.en: Equal corresponding angles stand on equal chords.
meaning.zh: 相等的對應角所對的弦相等。

meaning.en: Equal chords subtend equal corresponding angles.
meaning.zh: 等弦所對的對應角相等。

meaning.en: Equal chords cut off equal corresponding arcs.
meaning.zh: 等弦所對的對應弧相等。

meaning.en: Equal arcs have equal corresponding chords.
meaning.zh: 等弧所對的對應弦相等。

meaning.en: Arc lengths are proportional to their corresponding central angles.
meaning.zh: 弧長與所對的圓心角成比例。

meaning.en: Arc lengths are proportional to corresponding angles at the circumference.
meaning.zh: 弧長與所對的圓周角成比例。

meaning.en: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary.
meaning.zh: 圓內接四邊形的對角互補。

meaning.en: An exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals its interior opposite angle.
meaning.zh: 圓內接四邊形的外角等於內對角。

meaning.en: Equal angles standing on the same segment can establish concyclicity.
meaning.zh: 利用同弓形內角相等的逆定理證明四點共圓。

meaning.en: A quadrilateral with supplementary opposite angles is cyclic.
meaning.zh: 四邊形一對對角互補，則四點共圓。

meaning.en: A quadrilateral is cyclic if an exterior angle equals the interior opposite angle.
meaning.zh: 四邊形的外角等於內對角，則四點共圓。

meaning.en: Angles around a point sum to 360°.
meaning.zh: 一點四周的角度總和為三百六十度。

meaning.en: Vertically opposite angles are equal.
meaning.zh: 對頂角相等。

meaning.en: Adjacent angles on a straight line sum to 180°.
meaning.zh: 直線上的鄰角總和為一百八十度。
